name: Favicon Generator from Image
summary: Turn any logo into favicon.ico plus PNG sizes (16–512) with an HTML snippet — in your browser.
description: Upload an image, center-crop to a square, add optional padding and background, then download a multi-size favicon.ico, Apple touch icon, and Android Chrome PNGs. Includes ready-to-paste head link tags. Everything runs locally.

faqs.question: Is my logo uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation uses the Canvas API in your browser.

faqs.question: Non-square source images?
faqs.answer: We center-crop to the largest square before resizing.
